limitations: Uses the metric-only corpus (N_ingested), the widest denominator; duration itself carries no visual or script evidence. The analysis-ready corpus is not a random sample of the niche: deep.py only ever processed reels that score.py had already ranked near the top of their creator's output, so its median robust_z is above zero by construction. Any contrast computed inside it compares strong videos with other strong videos, not strong with average (docs/M2RADAR_ANALYSIS_METHOD.md §1.4).
method: Scatter of reel duration (from reels, newest reading) against robust_z, across the whole ingested corpus (not just analysis-ready).
title: Video duration vs performance
